async def use(items, operation, width):
    serial = 1
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, 1, operation)
    # ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, width=1, operation=operation)
    # ok: serial-bounded-helper-python
    map_with_concurrency(items, serial, operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, 4, operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, width=4, operation=operation)
    map_with_concurrency(items, width, operation)
